links.rationale: Baseline schedules are persisted so progress updates do not silently rewrite the quarterly commitment.
Overrides must affect the book's schedule while detaching it from a simultaneous group without destroying the shared schedule.
The baseline schedule must be stable and explainable across progress updates; it represents the explicit plan commitment.
